articles.summary: On 7 of December 2025, the European Commission unconditionally cleared Mars/Kellanova after an in-depth Phase II investigation. Unusually for a Phase II case, the Commission’s theory of harm revolved around ‘portfolio’ or ‘conglomerate’ effects. The Commission was concerned that post-merger, by jointly negotiating, the combined entity of Mars/Kellanova would improve their bargaining position vis-à-vis retailers […]
articles.title: CRA Competition advises on European Commission’s unconditional Phase II clearance of Mars/Kellanova
